data.gender_notes: Huraama is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-r-m' which means 'brightness, light'. This name signifies the brightness and light that a child brings into the world. The name Huraama carries the meaning “Brightness of light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Huraama usually hope their child will grow to embody brightness of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Huraama belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brightness of light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Huraama total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
